text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp has started, and once again, Manhattan Cafe seems to be communicating with someone or something from the beyond.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon explains that she's less interested in the true form of Manhattan Cafe's friend than in where this friend is trying to lead her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since there are more opportunities to talk during the summer camp, I figured it might be important to get a deeper understanding of her friend.
